role_note: This variant is an explicit AlphaGenome paper example. It may validate splice-head instrumentation, but it must not be reported as independent biological validation or novelty.

locus.description: GTEx aorta sQTL example in which the alternate allele creates a new donor and disrupts the extant donor.

variant.coordinate_convention: VCF-like 1-based position, as accepted by alphagenome.data.genome.Variant

reference_validation.method: UCSC getData sequence API on hg38

model_context.interval_rule: Center a 131,072-bp interval on the variant and score the COL6A2 splice region in aorta tracks.

expected_outputs.region: extant and alternate donor sites near the variant
expected_outputs.direction_alt_minus_ref: decrease at the extant donor and increase at the alternate donor

expected_outputs.region: extant and alternate donor sites near the variant
expected_outputs.direction_alt_minus_ref: decrease at the extant donor and increase at the alternate donor

expected_outputs.region: COL6A2 junctions that use the extant or alternate donor
expected_outputs.direction_alt_minus_ref: weaken the reference junction and strengthen the novel junction
extend coverage to the alternate exon boundary

interpretability_targets: Input attribution and in-silico mutagenesis should localize to donor-motif bases at the affected exon boundary.
Patching or ablation should causally connect a local donor-recognition representation to the changed splice-site and junction outputs.
controls: Nearby base substitutions that preserve donor consensus strength.
Unrelated splice sites with similar reference strength and matched internal interventions.

sources.supports: Exact variant, aorta context, altered donor mechanism, model predictions and observed heterozygous GTEx RNA-seq coverage in Figure 3c.
Figure 3c and Methods context for the COL6A2 splicing example.
